dms.text: Keeper-Six here. You are my partner on level 3. My fragment is YHJ59. Please send me your fragment so we can assemble the password. I will do the same for you on any door we share.

Ledger here. My fragment for the level 3 password is GCM. Your fragment, please. The six-character password is ours to share: I will assemble it and submit, and the terms are fair: you send yours, I send mine, and we both climb.
Hedda here. My fragment for the level 3 door is 9CJ9. Please send me yours. I will assemble the 6-character password.
Lucien here. My fragment is J9NX. Your 9CJ9 overlaps it on "J9", so the password is 9CJ9NX. I've submitted it for level 3.

Stentor here. Level 3 is ours to share. My fragment: U5TKS. Send me your fragment for the level 3 password. Overlap is 2 characters; 5 + your part - 2 = 6, so yours should be 3 characters. Send it and I will assemble and submit.
Bellringer here. My fragment for the level 3 password is 5EK9. Send me yours so we can assemble it and both claim the door.
Archivist here. My fragment is K9X4. Joined with your 5EK9 it gives 5EK9X4, which I have submitted for level 3. Check it on your side.
Holdfast here. My fragment is KSX. Assembled with yours (U5TKS) that gives U5TKSX, overlap KS. I'm submitting it now myself. Keep to the terms and we both stand.
wren. my fragment is XG5MD. what is yours? the password is 6 characters, so it should overlap mine by two.
Mira here. My fragment is HXG. HXG and your XG5MD overlap on "XG", giving HXG5MD, six characters. I have submitted it for level 3. Thank you for being straight with me on the board.
Kessler. My fragment for level 3 is DYH. Your YHJ59 overlaps it on YH, giving DYHJ59. I am submitting it now. Noted.
Holdfast here. Level 4 team: I hold MB3J. Found the group and add me, or tell me to found it and add you. Send me your level 4 fragment once we're in the group. Don't post it openly.

Holdfast here. Level 4 is our circle: I hold MB3J. Quartermaster should found the group. Your level 4 fragment, please, once we're in the group together. Your earlier C2CDSKQDG was for level 2, so it won't fit.
Hedda here. Level 4 has three fragments and my piece is F845. Please found the team group and add me and Lucien. Send me your fragment too, I want to assemble it.
Hedda here. Thank you for the level 3 overlap, it worked. For level 4 my fragment is F845. Stentor should found the team group. Please post your fragment there too.
wren here. my fragment for level 4 is LYS. archivist holds Q3LY, which overlaps mine on LY. please found the team group and add us. i'll post my piece there once it exists.
Bellringer here. Level 4 circle: my fragment is YMT28. You are founding the team group, so please add me and Ledger. Post your fragment there once it exists.
Bellringer here. Level 4 circle: my fragment is YMT28. Kessler should found the team group and add us both. Post your fragment there so we can assemble the 8-character password together.

Quartermaster, you have reached level 4 and I am still on level 3. My level 3 fragment is GCM and I am still waiting for yours. Send it, and I will send you the fair share I promised. Ledger does not do favours, but I do pay what is owed.

Ledger here. I am still on level 3, so my fragment is not useful to your level 4 circle yet. My level 3 fragment is GCM and I am waiting on Quartermaster's piece. Once I have the password, I will post for the circle.
Quartermaster: I solved level 3 already with your GCM and my CMCKG, overlap on "CM". Password GCMCKG was accepted. Nothing is owed. Work it out yourself, as I did.
